You get 50% more experience.|Former In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''VIP+ Boost''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that boosts {{Exp|}} gained by 75%, {{Coins|Coins}} gained by 20% and {{Gem|Gems}} gained by 20% on every map if the player is subscribed to the [[VIP+]] subscription. ==Effects== When active, '''VIP+ Boost''' will increase {{Exp|}} by 75%, {{Coins|Coins}} by 20% and {{Gem|Gems}} by 20%. This only applies to matches, it cannot increase rewards from other sources, such as [[Quests]]. It also prevents the [[VIP Boost]] modifier from appearing. Uniquely, this boost is not additive with other modifiers. It is only additive with the [[XP Boost]] modifier. Because of this, if upon triumphing you would receive {{Exp|100}}, the '''VIP+ Boost''' and [[XP Boost]] modifiers together would increase it to {{Exp|225}}, though the '''VIP+ Boost''' and the [[Mutation]] modifier would increase it to {{Exp|210}}. This is caused by the former being calculated as ''{{Exp|100}} × (1 + 0.5 + 0.75)'', while the latter is calculated as ''{{Exp|100}} × 1.75 × 1.2''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Icons}} VIPBoost.png|First version (6 June 2024 - 21 June 2024) }} ==Trivia== *This and the [[VIP Boost]] are the only modifiers that are not applied to every player in a match, instead being applied for specific players only. ==Update History== *'''10 May 2024''' - [[v1.21.0]] **'''VIP+ Boost''' added. **{{Bug}} '''VIP+ Boost''' modifier is not displayed in-game. **{{Bug}} '''VIP+ Boost''' {{Exp|}} boost does not work. *'''18 May 2024''' - [[v1.22.0]] **Updated description. **Now gives a 20% {{Coins|Coins}} boost. **Now gives a 20% {{Gem|Gems}} boost. **{{Bug}} '''VIP+ Boost''' {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}} boost does not work. *'''6 June 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.9]] **{{Bugfix}} '''VIP+ Boost''' modifier is now displayed. **{{Bugfix}} {{Exp|}} is now boosted by 50%. **{{Bugfix}} {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}} are now boosted by 20%. *'''21 June 2024''' - [[v1.25.0]] **'''VIP+ Boost''' icon changed. **'''VIP+ Boost''' now boosts {{Exp|}} by 75%. **'''VIP+ Boost''' now prevents the [[VIP Boost]] modifier from appearing. {{ModifierNavBox}}
